name: 90094 · Playa Vista, CA
findings: ZIP 90094 (Playa Vista) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90094 (Playa Vista) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90094 (Playa Vista) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
